query: List all customers from the city of São Paulo.
baseline_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c WHERE c.city ilike '%São%Paulo%' ORDER BY c.customer_id NULLS LAST;
cav_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c WHERE c.city ilike '%São%Paulo%' ORDER BY c.customer_id NULLS LAST;

query: Show all tracks with a unit price greater than 0.99.
baseline_sql: SELECT t.track_id, t.unit_price FROM track t WHERE t.unit_price > 0.99;
cav_sql: SELECT t.track_id, t.unit_price FROM track t WHERE t.unit_price > 0.99;

query: Show the names of customers and the total amount they have spent.
baseline_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(i.total) AS total_spent FROM invoice i JOIN customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC NULLS LAST;
cav_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(i.total) AS total_spent FROM invoice i JOIN customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC NULLS LAST;

query: List all albums by the artist AC/DC.
baseline_sql: SELECT a.title FROM album a JOIN artist ar ON a.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE ar.name ilike '%AC/DC%' ORDER BY a.title NULLS LAST;
cav_sql: SELECT a.title FROM album a JOIN artist ar ON a.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE ar.name ilike '%AC/DC%' ORDER BY a.title NULLS LAST;

query: Find the names of tracks in the Rock genre.
baseline_sql: SELECT t.name FROM track t JOIN genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE g.name ilike '%Rock%';
cav_sql: SELECT t.name FROM track t JOIN genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE g.name ilike '%Rock%';

query: Show the name and email of the support representative for each customer.
baseline_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, e.email FROM customer c JOIN employee e ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id;
cav_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, e.email FROM customer c JOIN employee e ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id;

query: List the track names and their album titles for all tracks sold in invoice ID 1.
baseline_sql: SELECT t.name AS track_name, a.title AS album_title FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN album a ON t.album_id = a.album_id WHERE il.invoice_id = 1;
cav_sql: SELECT t.name AS track_name, a.title AS album_title FROM invoice_line il JOIN track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN album a ON t.album_id = a.album_id WHERE il.invoice_id = 1;

query: Which customers bought tracks from the Jazz genre?
baseline_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN invoice_line i ON c.customer_id = i.invoice_id JOIN track t ON i.track_id = t.track_id WHERE t.genre_id IN (SELECT genre_id FROM genre WHERE name ILIKE '%Jazz%');
cav_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id JOIN invoice_line il ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id WHERE t.genre_id IN (SELECT genre_id FROM genre WHERE name ILIKE '%Jazz%');

query: Show the total revenue generated by each genre.
baseline_sql: SELECT g.name AS genre_name, SUM(t.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM track t JOIN genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;
cav_sql: SELECT g.name AS genre_name, SUM(t.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM track t JOIN genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;

query: How many tracks does each album contain? Show album title and count.
baseline_sql: SELECT a.title, COUNT(t.track_id) AS track_count FROM album a JOIN track t ON a.album_id = t.album_id GROUP BY a.title ORDER BY track_count DESC NULLS LAST;
cav_sql: SELECT a.title, COUNT(t.track_id) AS track_count FROM album a JOIN track t ON a.album_id = t.album_id GROUP BY a.title ORDER BY track_count DESC NULLS LAST;
